title: City of San Diego Unveils "Julia Legaspi Way"
description: SAN DIEGO, CA – A Mira Mesa resident and local civil rights leader will be recognized on Wednesday as Mayor Todd Gloria, Assemblymember Chris Ward, Council President Pro Tem Kent Lee, and community leaders will unveil an honorary street name sign in memory of the late Julia Legaspi on her birthday. The City Council voted on October 21, 2025, to approve a proposal by City Council President Pro Tem Kent Lee to authorize the honorary street renaming.
